name: trance
what: Trance production from the Exoplanet demo (docs/demo_study): long filter openings instead of short sweeps (its 85 automation clips open filters over 130 to 260 beats), a 16-bar build with a snare that rises an octave, an impact on the drop, a reverb throw and a long downlifter into each breakdown. The loudest section of Exoplanet's render swings only 0.9 dB over a beat, so the pump is on the bass alone and kept medium.
section_gains_how: Not applied blind: after the first render read measure_section_levels' contrast and run apply_section_gains with by_role {'scale': x}, aiming from the measured slope (tools/remix_song.py does this).
